title: Selection-Safe Conformal Early Exit: Distribution-Free Coverage under Adaptive Depth
abstract: arXiv:2610.20773v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Calibrating a conformal prediction set at each early exit does not preserve coverage once a data-dependent exit is selected. We construct one terminal path score from prefix maxima, calibrate a single split-conformal quantile, and return nested prefix sets that all contain the valid terminal set. The guarantee is selection-safe without an alpha/L correction and holds simultaneously for every post-calibration label-free stopping policy that preserves terminal-set containment. We also bound the efficiency cost of the path maximum by the empirical tail of the early-over-terminal score excess. Across eight encoder task-backbone cells, pathwise selection attains macro coverage 0.901 versus 0.814 for naive layerwise selection, with average set size 1.41 and latency fraction 0.71. On CIFAR-100 with a 24-exit ViT-L/16 (n_cal=500), first-eligible stopping at budget b=4 attains coverage 0.902, set size 2.76, and latency fraction 0.57, and the same

translated_title: 选择安全的保形早退：自适应深度下的无分布覆盖保证
translated_abstract: 在每个早退点分别校准保形预测集，一旦选择了依赖于数据的退出点，便无法保持覆盖率。我们从各层前缀最大值构造一个终端路径分数，校准单一的分隔保形分位数，并返回全部包含有效终端集的嵌套前缀集。该保证无需 alpha/L 修正即具有选择安全性，并且同时适用于所有在校准之后仍保持终端集包含关系的无标签停止策略。我们还通过早退分数超出终端分数部分的经验尾部，界定了路径最大值带来的效率损失。在八个编码器任务-主干组合的实验中，路径级选择方法达到 0.901 的宏覆盖率，而朴素的逐层选择仅为 0.814，同时平均集合大小为 1.41，延迟比例为 0.71。在 CIFAR-100 上使用具有 24 个退出点的 ViT-L/16（n_cal=500）时，预算 b=4 下的首次满足条件停止策略达到覆盖率 0.902、集合大小 2.76 和延迟比例 0.57，且同样的（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种选择安全的保形早退方法，通过前缀最大值构造的终端路径分数和单一保形分位数校准，在任意数据依赖的提前退出策略下均能保证无分布覆盖率，无需 alpha/L 修正，且实验表明其覆盖率显著优于朴素的逐层选择方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a selection-safe conformal early exit method that guarantees distribution-free coverage under any label-free adaptive stopping policy by calibrating a single terminal path score derived from prefix maxima, eliminating the need for alpha/L correction while significantly outperforming naive layerwise selection.
